title: Emergency Response Routing
desc: A Meta Quest 3 app where you pick a dispatch station and an incident in a 68-intersection city, then watch BFS, Dijkstra and A* search for the route step by step.
features: Compare BFS (fewest roads), Dijkstra (fastest route) and A* (fastest route, guided by a heuristic) on the same start and end
Every visited intersection lights up as the search spreads, with a speed slider to slow it down
Info bar shows path length and how many nodes each algorithm had to visit
Point-and-trigger controls, spatial sound generated in code, and the whole UI built at runtime
challenge: Dijkstra and A* froze once travel costs got large: float keys in the SortedList priority queue lost precision, so the tie-breaker stopped making keys unique. Switching the keys to double plus a tiny insertion counter fixed it.
